scope: Proposition 5.2 (Energy identification under the sphere conditioning) of the manuscript “A Linear Clock for Random Walk on Tree-Weighted Planar Maps” (preprints/A-Linear-Clock-for-Random-Walk-on-Tree-Weighted-Planar-Maps-October-5-2026/linear-clock-random-walk-tree-weighted-planar-maps.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0acb1c84bf79e9c8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 39-40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Consider any joint subsequential extraction of the sphere contour and the countable internal variational arrays on Id, for every rational d ∈ (0, 1/2), using the extraction convention of Proposition 2.11. Almost surely, on every open domain compactly contained in the interior of one of these interval surfaces, 39 both primal and dual inner relaxed energies equal D. This identity holds simultaneously for all continuous targets, with the value +∞ when the target is not locally Sobolev or its Dirichlet integral diverges.
